definitions.gloss: final stage, terminal phase, end period
definitions.explanation: The last stage or closing period of something, whether a historical era, a process, or a disease. Often implies decline or approaching end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末期|まっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開国|かいこく}→開国：14660_kaikoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japan opened its borders in the final period of the Edo era.

examples.japanese: {末期|まっき}がん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was diagnosed with terminal cancer.

examples.japanese: ローマ⟦{帝国|ていこく}→帝国：12420_teikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末期|まっき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Politics were in turmoil in the final period of the Roman Empire.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier: {末期|まっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or as a prefix: {末期|まっき}がん (terminal cancer). Very common in both historical contexts (the final period of an era) and medical contexts (terminal stage of a disease). Also read as まつご in the compound {末期|まつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water given to a dying person).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {末期|まっき}がん: terminal cancer
- {末期|まっき}⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧: terminal symptoms
- ～⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末期|まっき}: final period of the ~ era
- {末期|まっき}{的|てき}: end-stage, decadent
